verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own docs say developers can start using Pipedream MCP for free in development mode, and that it offers a generous free plan with free Connect access while in development. That covers prototyping agent tool connections before paying. Whether the tier is meaningful cannot be judged, because no quotas, limits or development-mode restrictions are documented and nothing independent backs the 'generous' claim. Missing for 10: documented free-tier limits/quotas (tool calls, connected users, apps), details of what development mode restricts versus production, independent or hands-on corroboration that the free tier is meaningful.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype my agent's tool connections on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: To use Pipedream MCP in your own app or agent to make tool calls on behalf of your users, you can get started for free in development mode
Pipedream offers a generous free plan and free access to Pipedream Connect while in `development`.
